summary_1line: Arjuna respectfully rejects Urvasi’s advances, is cursed to become a eunuch, and Indra explains the curse will aid him during the Pandavas’ future incognito exile.

image_candidates.scene_text: Urvasi, trembling with rage and brows knit, curses the calm Arjuna in a celestial chamber of heaven.
Arjuna bows deeply before Urvasi with folded hands, refusing her and honoring her as a motherlike ancestor.
In Indra’s heavenly court, the sage Lomasa sees Arjuna seated beside Indra on half his throne among astonished gods and rishis.
